abilitygroupdescription.p: These abilities describe miscellaneous Challenges or Hazards that the PCs might have to face.

Pit Traps. Poisoned needles on chests Snares and Tripwires
Probably should move to the GMG.

check.name: Acidic Vapor Check
check.precondition: Triggered at the end of a round if any character is in a square that contains acidic vapours.
check.any-fail: If the character is not in a square containing Acidic Vapours then decrement the Stage.
check.critfail: Decrement the Stage twice or once if in a square containing Acidic Vapours.

stage.name: Very Mild
stage.description: Make a Willpower or Endurance check or cough loudly unless holding their breath.

stage.name: Mild
stage.description: Coughing and shortness of breath, make any Endurance or Perception Checks at disadvantage.

stage.name: Medium
stage.description: Coughing and Eye irritation make any Endurance or Perception Checks at disadvantage. Burning skin suffer 3 health each round.

stage.name: Severe
stage.description: Coughing and Eye irritation make any Endurance or Perception Checks at disadvantage. Burning skin suffer 6 health each round.
